description: This file defines the 'Blanks' class which implements conditional formatting rules related to blank and non-blank cell conditions within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It facilitates creation and parsing of conditional formatting rules for blank cells.

classes.name: Blanks
classes.description: A class that provides a wizard for creating and interpreting conditional formatting rules based on blank or non-blank cells within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the Blanks wizard with a specified cell range and optional inversion of the condition.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Sets the inversion flag for the conditional formatting rule.

methods.name: getExpression
methods.description: Generates and sets the formula expression for the conditional rule based on the inversion state.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Creates and returns a Conditional object representing the current configuration of the wizard.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates a wizard instance from an existing Conditional object.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls to set specific operations like 'notBlank', 'isBlank', etc., on the wizard.
